notes.title: ⚠️ New Artist Collaboration ⚠️
notes.content:
Hello Survivors !

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40039979/e3bfbf6b9d2ca5f4b5042bf29888597ce60e758d.gif

We're happy and proud to annonce our collab' with artist Maorizon on SUPERZGUN.

Maorizon is a very talented artist who works different expressive and unique styles, inspired by classics like Castlevania for example. We can't wait to see the energy she brings to the studio. You can check out examples of her work here 

We look forward to working with such a highly creative artist and we're excited to see KoalaBear Studio X Maorizon come to life in our upcoming zombie survivor game: SUPERZGUN.

We'll be back soon with more good news !

Cheers !

Alex
